messages:
nina: Found an external vendor tarball that contains a KMS-wrapped service account blob referencing our keyRing. filename: vendor_payload_2026-05-05.tar.gz. no plaintext tokens visible.

omar: env? roles?

nina: appears tied to staging; SA had broad roles (bigquery.viewer, storage.admin). header looks like: {"k":"projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/vendor/cryptoKeys/wrap","ct":"XYZ...=="}.

felix: treat as suspected exposure. Quick plan: 1) disable SA 2) snapshot audit logs 3) create new key and rewrap 4) rotate any CI secrets referencing it 5) coordinate vendor.

tess: oncall. disabling SA now and removing decrypt binding from key. running audit export to gs://redwood-audit/snapshots/1719999000.json.

sec-oncall-bot: Snapshot saved: gs://redwood-audit/snapshots/1719999000.json. Trigger: vendor-wrapped-blob-detected.

omar: we should NOT rewrap with same key. create partner-rollover key and perform re-encrypt, update Vault entries and vendor pointers. I'll own key creation and re-encrypt tooling.

nina: I'll scan repos, S3 prefixes, and GH packages for the SA email and key path. ETA 15m.

tess: applied temporary IAM condition to block decrypts from the exposed SA outside our maintenance CIDR for 48h.

felix: checklist for ticket: disable SA (tess), create replacement SA (omar), create new KMS key (omar), re-encrypt and push to vendor (omar), rotate CI secrets (nina), run forensics and postmortem (felix).

omar: reference commands for re-encrypt posted in ticket. will use Vault transit/rewrap where possible to minimize downtime.

nina: found two artifacts in vendor buckets and one GH package. contacting vendor for secure upload.

felix: good. after rotation run smoke tests and collect pre/post decrypt audit logs. I'll draft the postmortem template.

tess: update 1719999400 -- SA disabled, snapshot done. vendor confirmed maintenance window at 02:00 UTC. will update when rewrap completes.

omar: update 1719999400 -- new key created and deploy script ready. planning re-encrypt during window.

nina: will follow up with CI secret rotation after vendor confirms fetch.

felix: closing: make sure to add detection rule to scan for wrapped blobs in partner uploads and a pre-commit rule to block key path patterns. good job team. :thumbsup:
